column1: # ACRONYM MAP - the ALLOWLIST that drives acronym_check.py. Built 2026-09-10.
# WHY AN ALLOWLIST AND NOT AN EXCEPTIONS LIST. The industry rule (Microsoft Writing Style
# Guide, Hyperlint) flags every 3-5 letter capital token and exempts ~50 known-safe ones.
# MEASURED 2026-09-10 against Rob's live Instructions field: 1,951 matches, 1,926 surviving
# the 47-entry exceptions list, top hits THE x268, NOT x107, AND x103. His house style shouts
# for emphasis and English words are 3-5 letters, so a denylist is unusable here. Flagging
# ONLY tokens on this list makes false positives on emphasis impossible by construction; the
# failure mode becomes a missed acronym, which is one wrong word, instead of a gate nobody
# COLUMNS  token  class  expansion  scope  skip_regex  note
#   class      expand = must be spelled out at first use in a surface
#              never  = product/organisation name or universal token; NEVER flag, NEVER expand
#   scope      *  applies everywhere;  a name  applies only to that surface and WINS over *
#   skip_regex occurrences matching this are ignored entirely (empty = none)
# ADDING A ROW BY HAND IS FINE. harvest_acronyms.py appends candidates it finds in text that
# already expands correctly; those land with source=harvest and want a human glance.
#--- class three: genuine acronyms, expand at first use -------------------------------

MOVED FROM expand TO never 2026-09-10 ON A FOUR-PROJECT MEASUREMENT, AND IT IS ROB'S OWN CLASS-ONE RULE APPLIED RATHER THAN AN EXCEPTION TO IT. Measured across 2789 assistant turns outside the project this gate was tuned on: 123 AI flags, of which about 112 are a PROPER NAME - an Instagram collection literally called AI, plus its AI - rejected and AI - processed siblings, plus content titles such as 5 AI PM Portfolio Projects and 8 AI Skills That Future-Proof Developers. NO SPAN RULE AND NO NAME-FAMILY REGEX CAN FIX THAT, because the name IS the bare token and the family is unbounded - it grows whenever Rob names something. Class one says a name that only looks like an acronym is left alone. The cost is stated and accepted: roughly 11 genuine bare uses across those 2789 turns will no longer flag. FALSIFIER: if artificial intelligence starts appearing unexpanded in INSTRUCTION files, scope an expand row to those surfaces rather than making it global again.
